data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value: STRING FORMAT SPECIFIERS Convert numbers to formatted Strings before assignment. Syntax: value.ToString("Specifier") Common Format Specifiers: • "C2" -> Currency format: $155.63 • "N2" -> Number with 2 decimals: 1,250.50 • "N0" -> Whole integer, commas: 1,000 • "P1" -> Percentage format: 15.5%

data.name: RichTextBox3.Text
data.value: Levels of Scope: 1. Block: • Exists only within an If/Loop statement block. 2. Local (Dim): • Declared inside a Sub/Function. • Destroyed when End Sub executes. 3. Module-Level (Private): • Declared at the top of the Form class. • Accessible across all Subs until form closes. 4. Namespace (Public): • Accessible project-wide across all forms.
